studio.aiHint: Each scene shows what it explains, in any subject: animated equations and reactions, organs lighting up part by part, function graphs, timelines and maps for history and geography, sentence parsing for languages, comparisons, definitions, charts and real images. Everything is editable afterwards.
studio.podcastHint: Explain the lesson in your own voice. It gets transcribed, then slides follow what you say and questions land in the right places. Transcription limit is 25MB (about an hour of webm).
studio.autoQuestions: Add interactive questions automatically with AI
studio.uploadHint: Videos under 25MB are transcribed so questions land at the right moment; larger ones get questions from the curriculum spread across the video, which you can retime.
